FPT Tower Headquarters A trio of modern high-rise office buildings with white facades and blue-tinted windows rises behind a landscaped plaza. Three large stone monoliths in the foreground display the letters “F,” “P,” and “T” in blue, orange, and green, respectively, with illuminated water fountains on either side. The complex appears to serve as the corporate headquarters for FPT, a leading Vietnamese technology and IT services company. The clean lines, grid-like window patterns, and vibrant logo stones create a professional and dynamic urban environment, reflecting the company’s growth and modern identity.

Long Châu Vaccination Center at Khánh Hội At the corner of Khánh Hội and Hoàng Diệu streets in District 4, a distinctive red-and-blue cylindrical building stands out with bold signage for "Tiêm chủng Long Châu" and an FPT Shop electronics store. The vaccination center advertises services for both children and adults, while the ground floor displays Samsung and Apple accessories. A steady flow of motorbikes and scooters pauses at the crosswalk, reflecting the typical traffic of Ho Chi Minh City.

The metadata reveals that this location at 261-263 Khánh Hội operates daily from 7:30 to 18:30, offering modern medical equipment, electronic immunization records, and professional staff. The center sources vaccines from reputable manufacturers and maintains GSP-standard storage. headquarters.source_description:
Hoa Sen Group Headquarters A sleek, white-paneled office building stands under a clear blue sky, its curved corner accented by rows of green-tinted windows. Atop the roof, a large sign spells out “HOA SEN GROUP,” signaling the corporate identity of the structure. The modern facade and rooftop branding reflect the company’s professional image and urban presence.

Tập đoàn Hoa Sen vừa công bố kết quả kinh doanh quý II/2019 với lợi nhuận từ hoạt động kinh doanh đạt hơn 208 tỷ đồng, tăng 127%, và lợi nhuận sau thuế đạt 161 tỷ đồng, tăng 94% so với cùng kỳ năm trước. Doanh thu thuần quý II đạt 7.228 tỷ đồng, giảm 30% so với cùng kỳ, nhưng biên lợi nhuận gộp cải thiện lên 13,4% so với 9,99% cùng kỳ trước. Kết quả này đến từ việc tái cơ cấu, tập trung vào sản phẩm và thị trường có biên lợi nhuận cao, tiết giảm chi phí và quản lý hàng tồn kho. HSG cũng tái cấu trúc hệ thống chi nhánh, kết nối công ty mẹ với 10 nhà máy, 55 chi nhánh tỉnh và hơn 526 cửa hàng bán lẻ. Trong tương lai, HSG dự kiến mở rộng sản xuất, nâng cao chất lượng, phát triển hệ thống phân phối nội địa và xuất khẩu, tận dụng các hiệp định thương mại như CPTPP và EVFTA.

Rox Tower at Hồ Tùng Mậu A contemporary mixed‑use skyscraper stands prominently at a busy intersection in western Hanoi, its glass curtain walls and white concrete panels forming a striking grid pattern. Adjacent high‑rise residential blocks frame the scene, while motorbikes and cars circle a landscaped roundabout in the foreground. Large leasing signs—"CHOTHUE EVP 0932211688" and "TTTM 0963243663"—and the illuminated "ROX Center" logo mark the building’s commercial function.

Part of the Goldmark City development, Rox Tower Goldmark City offers over 97,000 m² of premium office space and 9,000 m² of retail area across 40 floors. International‑standard amenities include high‑speed elevators, central air conditioning, 24/7 security, and multi‑level parking. Situated at 136 Hồ Tùng Mậu, the tower benefits from direct connections to Metro Line 3, Mỹ Đình Stadium, and Nội Bài Airport, making it a prime business address in Hanoi’s Nam and Bắc Từ Liêm districts.

headquarters.source_description:
MB Grand Tower Office Building A contemporary high-rise office building dominates a city block in Hanoi’s Cầu Giấy district. The tower’s glass curtain wall is punctuated by vertical concrete fins, creating a modern aesthetic that reflects the surrounding skyline. At the podium level, a curved digital display greets visitors with the message “MB SỞ GIAO DỊCH 1 Kính chào.”

The 24-story structure, developed by MBLand Holdings under MB Bank and managed by CBRE Vietnam, offers 2,000 m² floor plates and four basement levels. Rental rates range from $16–21 per square meter per month, inclusive of service fees and VAT. Amenities include professional reception, 24/7 security, an on-site MB Bank branch, restaurants, and cafes. Located at 65 Lê Văn Lương, the tower benefits from easy access to major roads and nearby districts such as Đống Đa and Thanh Xuân.

headquarters.source_description:
Techcombank Tower in Ho Chi Minh City Foster + Partners’ second office tower for Techcombank stands 21 stories tall on a double-fronted plot in southern Vietnam. The building is expressed as two stacked blocks with the circulation core at the rear and a recessed floor for employee amenities. Entrances open onto Le Duan Boulevard and Nguyen Du Street, guiding visitors into a light-filled environment.

Three central atria rise through different levels, creating vertical voids that bring natural light deep into the office floors and host modular meeting “capsules” to encourage collaboration. The sawtooth façade, inspired by bamboo weaving, self-shades sun-facing edges with metal mesh screens while clear glass on the opposite faces offers unobstructed city views. Driven by environmental analysis, the tower’s orientation and shading system maintain comfort in the tropical climate and support its pursuit of LEED Platinum certification.

ROX Tower in Urban Skyline A striking blue‑glass skyscraper bearing the ROX and MSB logos rises next to a white residential high‑rise in a vibrant cityscape. The building’s lower levels display retail banners for Elite Fitness and Panasonic, while a broad, tree‑lined avenue filled with cars and motorbikes stretches into the distance. The late afternoon sun bathes the scene in golden light, highlighting the reflective facade and casting long shadows across the street.

This view captures the modern business district of Hanoi, where new developments like ROX Tower at Goldmark City exemplify the city’s rapid urban growth. The juxtaposition of sleek glass towers and older mid‑rise buildings illustrates the evolving skyline. Pedestrians and vehicles animate the thoroughfare, underscoring the area’s role as a bustling commercial hub.
